mustFix.problem: Crossfade between entries leaves two text blocks and two plates visible at once, both illegible mid-scroll
mustFix.fix: Hide the outgoing entry fully before the incoming one shows: swap with a clip wipe (clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0) -> inset(0)) or set visibility:hidden on the outgoing entry; never two entries above opacity 0 at the same scroll position

elevate.move: Make the story one continuous camera: the pinned SVG plate pans and scales to each part with no image crossfades, while each timestamp stamps a new row onto an accumulating ticket card (Arrived -> Reading -> Fixed) so the visitor watches the ticket fill in

Carry the ticket through the lower half so the page reads as one job sheet: services become work codes, pricing becomes a single ruled line-item sheet, and the form becomes the tear-off stub that closes the ticket, each band a different ticket part instead of stacked generic cards
